import re,html,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('products/research/catalogue-alt/matrixify-appstore.html').read_text(errors='replace')
t=re.sub(r'(?s)<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t)
s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t))
s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
res=[];seen=set()
for kw in ['\$','/month','Free plan','Demo','Basic','Big','Enterprise','products','variant','image','CSV','Excel','limit','rows','Rating','reviews']:
  for m in re.finditer(kw,s):
    o=kw+' | '+s[max(0,m.start()-150):m.end()+150]
    k=s[max(0,m.start()-60):m.end()+60]
    if k in seen: continue
    seen.add(k);res.append(o)
pathlib.Path('products/research/catalogue-alt/matrixify-extract.txt').write_text('LEN '+str(len(s))+'\n'+'\n'.join(res[:90]))
print(len(s),len(res))
